tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a.Original Equipment Manufacturers or b.Supplier to Original Equipment Manufacturers or c.ASRTU RC with OE Status or If the bidder is suppliers to OEM/ if the firm under ASRTU RC with OE Status for Tata OR Leyland OR Eicher for any one of the tendered King Pin or King Pin Repair Kit out of tendered items, the rates quoted for all other tendered items will be considered.d.Manufacturers with minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 4 crores for preceding continuous 3 years.In case of Suppliers to OEMs, the items covered in the Purchase Order & Invoice Copies placed by the OEMs viz., M/s. Ashok Leyland Ltd., M/s Tata Motors Ltd., and M/s. Eicher Motors Ltd., for any of the tendered King Pin/ King Pin Repair Kit part numbers during the year 2023-24/ 2024-25/ 2025-26 will be considered for all the tendered items,.In case of ASRTU rate Contract firms, the items covered in the valid RC with OE Status for any of the tendered King Pin/ King Pin Repair Kit part number, will be considered for all the tendered items.The Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing/ Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for all the three years.In addition to the audited statement of account, the tenderer should submit Annual GST return acknowledged by the concerned Tax Authority along with the pre-qualification offer for all the three years.The Tenderer should enclose a Verification Certificate from the Chartered Accountant stating that, the turnover details furnished in the audited statement of accounts have been verified by him and that are found correct. Failure to comply with this condition, the offer will be disqualified.
